name: Pulse
tagline: Correlation is never presented as causation.
summary: A privacy-first personal analytics and experimentation engine. It connects data from the rest of the ecosystem and turns it into evidence-graded findings, registered experiments and recommended actions — or an explicit 'no action is justified yet'.
publishGate: Upstream lifecycle is `incubating`. This entry publishes automatically once apps/registry.json marks Pulse `active`; `bun run registry:validate` reports the gate on every run.

authorship.role: Sole author — event schema, statistics, discovery, experiments and connector SDK.
built: The versioned universal event schema with DST-safe time maths, migrations and deduplication
The connector SDK and sync engine: consent enforcement, paging, cursors, backfill and health checks
The statistics and discovery layers — effect sizes, multiple-testing correction within families, confounder adjustment and confidence grading
Experiment design and analysis, and the synthetic benchmark users with planted true and null effects
notBuilt: The published statistical methods themselves — Theil-Sen, Mann-Kendall and Benjamini-Hochberg are existing methods, implemented here against reference values
The language models used for explanation and natural-language querying

caseStudy.problem: Personal analytics fails in a specific, predictable way. With twenty metrics there are hundreds of pairwise comparisons, and at p < 0.05 a good handful will look significant on pure noise. Any tool will find something. A tool that only finds things is worse than no tool, because it dresses noise up as self-knowledge.
caseStudy.approach: Make the honest answer a first-class output. Every finding must carry what was found, the supporting data, sample size, effect size, confidence, possible confounders, whether it is an observation, correlation, hypothesis or experimental result, and a recommended action — or an explicit statement that none is justified. That contract is a type with a validator, not a convention: a finding using causal language without experimental evidence is rejected before it reaches the UI.

architecture.summary: A framework-free analytics engine that runs in plain Node, with a thin React layer that only renders what the engine computed.
architecture.invariant: AI is never used to produce a number. Any narrative a model returns is scanned for numeric tokens, and every one must appear in the fact set the deterministic engine computed — a single unverifiable number rejects the whole narrative.

layers.name: events/
layers.role: Versioned universal event schema, DST-safe time maths, migrations, dedup, storage.

layers.name: connectors/
layers.role: Connector SDK and sync engine — consent, paging, cursors, backfill, health — with one module per source.

layers.name: statistics/ + discovery/
layers.role: Distributions, effect sizes, multiple-testing correction, power, seeded resampling, confounder detection and adjustment.

layers.name: experiments/ + hypotheses/
layers.role: Crossover, A/B and before-after design and analysis, with predicted direction and size registered before the run.

layers.name: synthetic/
layers.role: Benchmark users carrying planted true effects, planted null effects and a deliberately confounded relationship.

visuals.alt: Illustration of a finding card showing effect size, sample size, confidence grade and a confounder warning
visuals.caption: Illustration of the finding contract. Not a screenshot — no capture of the running app has been published yet.

metrics.label: Automated tests
metrics.method: `npm test` in apps/pulse. Count as stated in the project README; the portfolio's CI importer replaces this with the live figure from the Pulse workflow when a run is readable.

metrics.label: Independence floor
metrics.method: Group comparisons are computed on sitting-level cluster means, and nothing is published below 14 distinct days. Enforced in the discovery layer.

evidence.label: README — how Pulse avoids fooling you

outcomes.statement: The test suite asserts specificity as well as sensitivity: benchmark users carry planted null effects that must not be found, and a deliberately confounded relationship that must be flagged rather than endorsed.

A connector cannot accidentally skip a safety step — paging, cursors, health checks, consent enforcement, normalisation, validation and deduplication all come from the SDK, and `checkContract` verifies at test time that a connector only emits metrics it declared, within the ranges it declared.
A third-party connector's metrics start as `context` and never as outcomes, so an unvetted source cannot introduce something the discovery scan treats as a result.

tradeoffs.choice: Benjamini-Hochberg applied within each outcome metric's family rather than across the whole scan
tradeoffs.gained: Related questions are corrected together, which is the comparison structure that actually exists in the data.
tradeoffs.gaveUp: A single global correction would be simpler to explain; pooling unrelated questions over-corrects, so both the family size and the total scan have to be shown to the user instead.

tradeoffs.choice: Confounder adjustment rather than confounder disclaimers
tradeoffs.gained: Time of day, day of week, secular trend and session mix are each tested and effects re-estimated within strata, so an effect that survives means something.
tradeoffs.gaveUp: Substantially more machinery, and more findings get demoted — an effect losing more than a third of its size under adjustment is marked uncontrolled and never promoted to 'run an experiment'.

tradeoffs.choice: Crossover as the default experiment design
tradeoffs.gained: It removes the biggest confounder in personal data: the person changing over time.
tradeoffs.gaveUp: Longer studies and unsuitability for anything with strong carry-over effects.

lessons: The load-bearing tests are the specificity ones. Proving the engine finds a planted effect is easy; proving it does not find the planted non-effect is the part that makes the output worth reading.
`inconclusive` has to be a first-class experiment outcome. Without it, an underpowered null quietly gets reported as evidence of no effect.
